verdict.rationale: uv documents installing packages through `uv add`, a drop-in pip-compatible interface, and `uv tool install`/`uvx`, with support for alternative sources. Docs examples install requests and ruff, and community users report installing pytorch and publishing to and consuming from internal GitLab indexes. This implies access to the standard Python package ecosystem. One user notes some scientific packages exist only on conda, which uv does not support. missing for 10: explicit evidence naming the default registry (PyPI) and its scale or maintenance, and conda-channel coverage for conda-only packages.
